transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's really nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for seeing me. 

Um... well, my manager actually suggested I come in. I hope that's alright. It's really not a huge deal, I promise, I've just been... well, I guess I sort of scared everyone at work recently. I didn't mean to, of course! I just, um... I started kind of freezing up in the middle of service. Or I'd do things a little out of order, I guess. 

Like, the other day, I was just standing over by the soda station holding the cash drawer key, and I was just repeating table numbers out loud instead of actually closing out the checks. It sounds so silly and embarrassing when I say it out loud, doesn't it? I think I just got a little overwhelmed or mixed up. Is... is that the kind of thing you need to know?
When this happens, do you suddenly feel a wave of intense fear or panic?

Oh, no, not at all. I really hope it didn't sound like I was having a panic attack or anything like that! I promise I'm not making a big fuss out of it. I don't really feel scared when it happens... I just feel kind of, um, blank, I guess? Or maybe just really distracted. But I definitely don't feel any intense fear. 

Is... is that an okay answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information and not making it sound worse than it actually is.
When this happens, do you feel detached from yourself or like the world around you isn’t quite real?

Oh, no, definitely not. I know exactly who I am and where I am, I promise! The restaurant feels completely real, and... and I still feel like myself. I'm really not losing touch with reality or anything scary like that. I just get... well, a little stuck, maybe? Like my focus just sort of wanders off for a minute and I forget what I'm doing. 

I hope that makes sense? I just really want to be helpful and give you the right answers, so please let me know if I'm not explaining things well enough for you.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Oh, no, definitely not. Um, I actually try to stay really upbeat! You know, working in a restaurant, you kind of have to keep a smile on for the customers, and I really don't mind it. I don't feel sad or depressed at all, I promise. 

I mean, everybody has a slightly off day sometimes, right? But nothing serious like what you're asking about. My mood is really, totally okay. I'm generally a pretty happy person! 

Is... is that helpful? I know you're trying to figure out what's going on with me, and I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right pieces to the puzzle. I hope it's okay that I don't feel down!
Did something very stressful or upsetting happen shortly before these episodes started?

Oh, no, I don't think so. Everything has been... well, pretty normal, honestly! I mean, the restaurant gets a little busy sometimes, but it's really nothing I can't handle. I definitely wouldn't call it upsetting or, um, overly stressful or anything like that. 

I really hope that's okay? I know sometimes doctors look for a big stressful event to explain things, and I don't want to make your job harder by not having a good reason for why this is happening. But honestly, my life has been pretty good! Is... is that alright? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t seem to hear or see?

Um... well... I really don't want you to think I'm, you know, crazy or anything. It's honestly probably just because I'm tired after a long shift, I promise! But... well, sometimes, like when we're closing up the restaurant, or when I'm just home alone in my kitchen, I... I do hear a woman's voice. 

She'll just say my name, or sometimes she tells me I'm doing the drawer count wrong. It sounds so normal and clear that I actually answer her out loud before I even realize that... well, that nobody else is there, and nobody else heard it. 

I mean, it's just my brain playing tricks on me because I'm working hard, right? I really hope that doesn't sound too strange or bad. I just want to make sure I'm being completely honest with you so you have all the right information to help me. Is... is it okay that I told you that?
